notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.1
notes.notes:
A couple of balance updates and bug fixes. I'll still be keeping an eye out for additional feedback and suggestions.



Change log:

Balance updates for the first area of the Abyss:

Immortal Knight midboss: Reduced his number of revives by 1, and slightly lowered the base damage of his attacks.

Vampire Lord boss: Lowered the damage of some attacks. In Phase 2, the “Elusive” and “Mobile” status effects will only last a few turns, and Evasion won’t be used as much.

Fixed a bug where removing the Undying status from the enemy in the Occult Manor's Vampire Maid event could result in an unwinnable battle.

Made a fix that should hopefully prevent spells from getting stuck in a semi-transparent, unusable state.

Fixed the way the Multi-Attack sigil would combine with certain other sigils, like Barrier Bash.

Some sigils, like Hex or Poisonblight, will gain +5 damage from being combined in this way, because Multi-Attack normally deals 5 damage itself.

However, for balancing the Charged Spell and Barrier Bash sigils will not have this extra damage added.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes - v0.9.2
notes.notes:
A small update to the demo. Some additional updates will be coming later, with the full game release on September 12th.



Change log:

Fixed a bug where the second dungeon, the Occult Manor, was sometimes available despite not being a selectable dungeon

Fixed a bug with Shop Favors where selecting a card for enhancement then canceling would still enhance the selected card

notes.title: Release Date Set for September 12th
notes.notes:
Magecraft: Spellbuilding will be released on Friday, September 12th, 2025, around 5am PDT.



This full release will include:

A total of 3 dungeons (2 new ones in addition to the demo's Fae Forest dungeon)

More than 64 Sigils to collect and use in Spellbuilding

The Abyss - a separate mode that takes advantage of more rogue-lite elements, such as randomized starting characters and decks



The save data from the demo is compatible with the full release, and should be picked up automatically when the game is started.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes - v0.7.7
notes.notes:
Change log:

The Player’s shield spells now last into the next turn, instead of disappearing at the end of the turn that the shield was applied

Allies can now be dismissed from battle when desired, allowing you to free up space to summon a different ally

This can be done by clicking the X that appears next to the HP bar of allies that can be dismissed.

This works for all summons and for some other allies. However, certain allies are not allowed to be dismissed.

Updated the Sneak Attack effect:

The description is now more clear (“Bypasses enemy attacks” instead of “Sneak Attack damage”).

Buffed with an additional effect: A chance to land a critical hit (which multiplies damage by 2).

Receiving the Sneak Attack Sigil now only gives you the Sneak Attack modifier (which can be applied to damaging spells in Spellbuilding), not the status effect (which is being removed in favor of the buffed modifier).

Updated the Pierce effect:

The description is now more clear (“Pierces through enemy attacks” instead of “Piercing damage”).

Buffed with an additional effect: Ignores shields when dealing damage.

Fixed the enemy Fruit Throw attack: the healing effect now matches the Power number shown, instead of being stuck at 5

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes - v0.7.6
notes.notes:
Change log:

Removed the limit for how many buffs / debuffs can be applied to a fighter

The UI will now expand to show up to 20 status effects. Additional statuses after 20 won't be shown, but will still take effect.

The Spellbuilding menu now prevents you from adding more than one element to a spell (which has no additional effects)

Increased drop rate of the Shadow Mote material

Partially fixed a bug where spells that damage the user did not follow through with damaging the user if the spell’s target was slain

Note: If this happens to the last remaining enemy, the player victory will take precedence and still prevent the self-damage from happening. This may be fixed in a future update, but will remain for now as a side effect of landing the winning blow.

Increased mana cost of Life Force scroll to 2 mana

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes - v0.7.5
notes.notes:
Change log:

Spells can now be used in multiple Decks at once, so you no longer need to remove Spells from one Deck in order to use them in another.

As part of this change, the Inventory now shows all Spells you own, including those added to Decks.

Combatants with an elemental affinity now have their element shown in a small emblem next to their HP bar.

These emblems also show up in the Elements popup (accessible via the icon with the three circles at the bottom left of the Combat screen).

Extra Parchment can now be bought from the Shop.
